title: David’s Charge to Solomon

questions.question: Who did David assemble to hear his charge?
options: All the officials of Israel, the officials of the tribes...
questions.correctAnswer: All the officials of Israel, the officials of the tribes...
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:1 (ESV): "David assembled at Jerusalem all the officials of Israel..."

questions.question: Why did David say he couldn’t build the temple?
options: Because he was a man of war and had shed blood
questions.correctAnswer: Because he was a man of war and had shed blood
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:3 (ESV): "...You shall not build a house... because you are a man of war and have shed blood."

questions.question: Who did the LORD choose to sit on the throne?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:5 (ESV): "...he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne..."

questions.question: What did David give to Solomon?
options: The plan of the vestibule of the temple, its houses, its treasuries...
questions.correctAnswer: The plan of the vestibule of the temple, its houses, its treasuries...
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:11 (ESV): "Then David gave Solomon his son the plan of the vestibule of the temple..."

questions.question: Who would be with Solomon until the work was finished?
options: The LORD God, even my God
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD God, even my God
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:20 (ESV): "...The LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not leave you or forsake you..."

questions.question: How was Solomon to serve God?
options: With a whole heart and with a willing mind
questions.correctAnswer: With a whole heart and with a willing mind
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:9 (ESV): "...serve him with a whole heart and with a willing mind..."

questions.question: What happens if you seek Him?
options: He will be found by you
questions.correctAnswer: He will be found by you
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:9 (ESV): "...If you seek him, he will be found by you..."

questions.question: From where did David get the plan?
options: The Spirit (it was all in writing from the hand of the LORD)
questions.correctAnswer: The Spirit (it was all in writing from the hand of the LORD)
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:12, 19 (ESV): "...the plan of all that he had in mind by the Spirit... All this he made clear to me in writing from the hand of the LORD..."

questions.question: Who would help Solomon in all the work?
options: The priests and the Levites, and every willing man
questions.correctAnswer: The priests and the Levites, and every willing man
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:21 (ESV): "...And behold the divisions of the priests... and every willing man... will be with you..."

questions.question: What material was provided for the lampstands?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:15 (ESV): "...weight of the golden lampstands... and the weight of the silver lampstands..."

questions.question: What was the gold for the altar of incense described as?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:18 (ESV): "...and refined gold for the altar of incense..."

questions.question: What did the plan for the golden chariot represent?
options: The cherubim that spread their wings and covered the ark
questions.correctAnswer: The cherubim that spread their wings and covered the ark
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:18 (ESV): "...and the plan for the golden chariot of the cherubim that spread their wings and covered the ark..."

questions.question: Of which tribe was David?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:4 (ESV): "...For he chose Judah as leader..."

questions.question: What did David say God does to every heart and thought?
options: Searches all hearts and understands every plan and thought
questions.correctAnswer: Searches all hearts and understands every plan and thought
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:9 (ESV): "...for the LORD searches all hearts and understands every plan and thought."

questions.question: What encouragement did David give Solomon regarding fear?
options: Be strong and courageous and do it. Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed
questions.correctAnswer: Be strong and courageous and do it. Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 28:20 (ESV): "...Be strong and courageous and do it. Do not be afraid and do not be dismayed..."

key_verse_text: And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve him with a whole heart and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches all hearts and understands every plan and thought. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
